job.job_description:
Design and develop Agentic AI solutions leveraging autonomous agents, planning, reasoning, memory, and tool-calling capabilities.
Build and optimize RAG pipelines using vector databases and enterprise knowledge repositories.
Develop AI applications using LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, and related frameworks.
Integrate and orchestrate LLMs such as Azure OpenAI, GPT, Claude, or Gemini into business workflows.
Create and maintain scalable Python-based APIs and microservices for AI solutions.
Implement prompt engineering, model evaluation, observability, and monitoring for AI systems.
Deploy and manage AI applications on Microsoft Azure using Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Studio, Azure AI Search, Azure Functions, and related services.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into AI-powered solutions.
Ensure security, governance, and Responsible AI best practices across deployments.
